answer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(Tags LIKE '%<r>%'), 0) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = -1
note: No Community post has Tags set, so 0.0

answer: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Score > 50) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT u.Id FROM users u JOIN badges o ON o.UserId = u.Id AND o.Name = 'Organizer' WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Date < o.Date) >= 5 GROUP BY u.Id)

SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation FROM users WHERE (Location LIKE '%California%' OR Location LIKE '%, CA%' OR Location LIKE '% CA' OR Location = 'CA') AND Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users WHERE Location LIKE '%California%' OR Location LIKE '%, CA%' OR Location LIKE '% CA' OR Location = 'CA')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) FROM users u JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE b.Name = 'Yearling' AND b.Date < '2014-01-01' AND u.Location LIKE '%India%' AND u.Location NOT LIKE '%Indiana%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(p.OwnerUserId AS TEXT), 'n:' || p.OwnerDisplayName)) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON p.Id = v.PostId WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30 AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01' AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
